notes.title: Update coming up: more arenas
notes.content: Last week we had a great showcase of Soccer Nations Battle at indie game showcase Indigo (Utrecht, Netherlands). We tested a bunch of new arenas for the game: for instance an arena on a moving ship, and an underwater arena. We're polishing these arenas a bit and will then update the game here on Steam. Looking forward to see what you think of them!
